name: labs/wetenschaap__pycrofluidics
title: Elveflow OB1 pressure controller (pycrofluidics.OB1elve)
intro: Elveflow OB1 pressure controller (pycrofluidics.OB1elve), adapted from wetenschaap/pycrofluidics. It reads `flow_1`, `flow_2`, `flow_3`, `flow_4` and 1 more; sets `pressure_1`, `pressure_2`, `pressure_3` and `pressure_4`; runs `read_pressure`, `read_flow`, `start_remote` and `stop_remote`. `read_pressure`: read the pressure of one OB1 channel and return it in mbar. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
